label: D2 after a2 -> S2 (common) when the previous trial was unrewarded and the a2 preference is not strong
explanation: Fires only at D2, and only when the agent chose a2 and reached S2 by a common transition (100% of activations; zero on D1, GO, a1, S1 or rare transitions). Among those steps it is gated by the previous trial being unrewarded (89% of mass) and by the model policy logit at that step not being strongly a2 (choice > -3.5; it is silent once a2 is strongly preferred). Rate also falls off late in the episode (almost silent after trial 80). The base a2/S2c condition alone has P=0.20; adding prev_reward==0 and the choice gate gives dev P=0.74 R=0.78 F1=0.76 mass 0.89. Missed activations are mostly weak ones after a rewarded previous trial (often switch trials to a2). All variables are observable at D2 (choice is the agent own logit).
